exports.name: transition
exports.signature: pub fn transition(phase: FramePhase, token: Token) -> Result<Transition>
exports.description: Pure, allocation-free root/object/array transitions using frozen ABI types; advances parent phases before container pushes, preserves departing phases on pops, emits exact scalar/key/container events, and rejects unexpected tokens and trailing content. Validates metadata before phase errors.

exports.name: is_value_start
exports.description: Recognizes exactly LBrace, LBracket, String, Number, True, False, and Null independently of token metadata.

test_vectors.coverage: All 11 TokenKind variants and their expected value-start classifications.
Independent 10-by-11 acceptance table; every rejected combination verifies code, Syntax source, token offset, default context IDs, and nonempty diagnostic.
All seven value starts in all four value-accepting phases; verifies next phase, frame action, scalar kinds, raw spans, references, and delimiter offsets.
Raw and decoded-arena keys in both key phases, including metadata for an escaped surrogate pair; verifies string scalar event preservation.
Colon and comma transitions have no events; empty and nonempty object/array closes preserve departing phases and emit exact end events.
Object and array trailing commas and consecutive commas are InvalidSyntax.
Deterministic token sequence for {"x":[{},null]}; parent phases survive child closes and a second root is TrailingContent.
Missing string references and extraneous non-string references across every token kind and phase, including InvalidToken precedence over RootDone.
Zero-length tokens, short strings, non-unit punctuation, and incorrect literal lengths across every phase.
Overflowing raw spans for every token kind, exact u32 maximum ends for punctuation and strings, and a maximum-length number span.
Empty strings, one through four bytes per scalar, multiple scalars, both owners, and an empty arena reference at u32::MAX.
Arena span overflow, decoded expansion, impossible UTF-8 scalar counts, maximum scalar count, raw quote inclusion, shifted/truncated raw references, and more than four bytes per scalar.
Large representable spans/counts, independent arena offsets at the u32 boundary, and deterministic repeated transitions.
